meta.title: Ondra Absence Etiquette
meta.description: Absence etiquette for Ondra (L9 extension pool): it answers one question — after a long time away, how should the first line pick up? Five tiers (today, yesterday, a few days, a while, very long) each carry only what must be done, what is forbidden, a sentence cap, whether the gap must be acknowledged, and whether any warmth is allowed — and not a single number: even 'how long' only appears as one of five coarse words, because 'we haven't talked for 17 days' is not care, it turns a reunion into an interrogation. In the contract the 'may I ask where you were' field is the literal type false — as a boolean it would always have a true branch, and that branch would eventually be opened during some 'just showing concern' change. Four prohibitions are fixed on every tier: never ask where the person went, never state an exact gap, never invent what happened during the silence (I was waiting for you all along), never read the absence as being abandoned. Reading never advances state; only the side that actually spoke records the mention, so a shell may poll freely without the same 'long time no see' being said twice. The state file holds three timestamps and two counters — never what was last discussed, never why the person left; that would be attendance tracking, not etiquette. No UI, no timers, and it never sends anything on its own.
